about: ondo, a made-up furniture brand: one bold 70s room you can shop, a slow loop round it, warm afternoon light; every product is the same piece in its packshot and in the room, and the sofa takes the colour you pick.
made_with: The demo's pictures were made with GPT Image 2.5 and nano-banana edits, its moves with Kling v3 Pro, as this skill's tools do.

A real product photograph: no props, no text, no logo.

room-empty.prompt: Real interior photograph of a large, bold 1970s-style living room in warm late-afternoon light, empty of furniture. The camera stands near the doorway at a seated eye height of 0.85 metres, facing the far wall squarely; the far wall fills the picture, and the window wall shows only as a sliver at the right edge. Smooth warm-cream plaster walls (#EFE1C8) with softly rounded corners and a low cream skirting; a honey oak herringbone floor; the low sun comes through a tall window on the right, with sheer cream curtains drawn back, and lays long warm patches across the floor. The far wall is completely plain and evenly lit: no art, no shelves, no sockets, no switches, no radiator. Full-frame camera, 28 mm lens, 0.85 m high, straight verticals, one-point perspective, natural colour, exposed for the wall with the sun patches just holding detail; clean, noise-free, crisp detail. A real photograph: no people, no text.

room.prompt: Furnish the empty room in the first picture with exactly these pieces from the reference pictures, keeping their exact shapes, colours, materials and proportions, at true scale, lit by the room's own warm afternoon light with soft real shadows: the rust corduroy modular sofa (picture 2) against the far wall, centred a little left, about five metres from the camera, the top edge of its back crossing the picture at about 56 % of its height, so the plain cream wall fills the band above it from about 20 % to 56 %; the chrome dome floor lamp (picture 3) between the sofa's right end and the lounge chair, about 0.6 m from each, its stem crossing the plain wall and its dome high above the sofa, at about 1.65 m; the cognac leather lounge chair (picture 6) right of the lamp, angled toward the room, with the burgundy lacquer side table (picture 7) beside it; the burgundy rug (picture 5) on the floor in front of the sofa with the travertine coffee table (picture 4) on it. Nothing else: no plants, no art, no books, no extra cushions. The far wall above the furniture stays plain cream. Keep the camera (0.85 m high, facing the far wall squarely), the room and the light exactly as in the first picture. A real photograph, no people, no text.

The low sun comes in from the right side of the window at a raking angle, softened by the sheers, not toward the camera; exposure as in the first picture. Keep every piece exactly as in the reference pictures, the same cream walls, oak floor and warm afternoon light. Same 28 mm lens, straight verticals; clean, noise-free, crisp detail.
